findings.what: The Go back script goes back only when `ours && history.length > 1`. The spec decision says it goes back when document.referrer is same-origin, and it rejected history.length as a criterion. The extra guard is a condition the decision doesn't state.
findings.fix: Remove `&& history.length > 1` so the condition is only the same-origin referrer.

findings.what: The Go back behaviour is checked only by a regex over the script text, which would pass with the wrong condition. That is how the extra history.length guard went unnoticed. The state table's 'Go back hidden' cells for the 200 rows are also never asserted.
findings.fix: Assert the exact referrer condition. Assert that 200 pages contain no 'Go back' or corrupted-link message.

findings.what: The 'No items yet.' empty-table test (state row 2) doesn't check that the filter links are shown with All current. The 'known category with items' state doesn't check that no message is shown.
findings.fix: Add assertions for the filter links on the empty table. Assert there is no message on the populated pages.

findings.what:
The 404 page adds an `

Broken link

` heading and a 'Broken link' title that the spec doesn't call for.
findings.fix: Drop the heading, or record it in the spec.
